[[File:ChazwaStar-TLC2.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Chazwa (star)|Chazwa]] was a [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Dwarf star/Legends|dwarf]].]]
{{Quote|&hellip;located the station in close orbit around a white dwarf. We believe the Republic intended to destroy it in the sun's photosphere.|[[Jarr]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Hammer Station}}</ref>}}
A '''white dwarf''' was a small [[Star/Legends|star]] formed at the end of a small to medium mass star's evolution. These stars could no longer sustain [[nuclear fusion]] of [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]], and only gave off faint light from their residual [[Temperature/Legends|heat]]. [[Ardos/Legends|Ardos]], one of two stars of the original [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], became a [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Dwarf star/Legends|dwarf star]] around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], at the end of the [[Hutt Cataclysms]]. Around the same time, Ardos's sister star [[Evona/Legends|Evona]] was swallowed by a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]], and the resulting devastation rendered the entire [[Varl system/Legends|Varl system]] uninhabitable. The story later became a Hutt legend about the two stars, which were considered [[Deity/Legends|gods]] by the Hutts; according to the legend, Evona was lured into a collision with a small black hole and [[Death/Legends|died]], causing the [[Star system/Legends|systems]]' [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to violently mourn their death and crush each other into [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. In agony, Ardos began to self-destruct and transformed into a white dwarf. However, inconsistencies in the story led many to believe that Evona's destruction and Ardos's transformation were caused by the Hutts themselves.<ref name="Galaxy">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]] briefly held a base on a frozen planet orbiting a white dwarf, and was tracked to his hideout by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].
